manifest.name: Quota Monitor
manifest.description: Claude · GPT · Antigravity의 5시간·주간 잔량과 계정 수를 2줄 미니 막대 타일과 팝오버로 표시합니다(데스크톱 상단 바, 모바일 사이드바 상단). Antigravity는 좌측 Gemini · 우측 Claude/GPT 잔량입니다.

components.Gauge:
{#if visible}
{#each items as gauge (gauge.id)} {/each}
{/if}
components.Ring:
{ if (hovering(e)) later(show, OPEN_DELAY); }} onpointerleave={(e) => { if (hovering(e)) later(hide, CLOSE_DELAY); }} onpointerdown={(e) => { pointerDown = true; if (e.pointerType === "touch" && details) (open ? hide() : show()); }} onpointerup={() => setTimeout(() => { pointerDown = false; }, 0)} onfocus={() => { if (!pointerDown) show(); }} onblur={() => { pointerDown = false; later(hide, CLOSE_DELAY); }} >
{#if gauge.icon} {/if}

{#if col.dual}
{#if col.top.known && col.top.ratio > 0}
{/if}
{#if col.bottom.known && col.bottom.ratio > 0}
{/if}
{:else}
{#if col.known && col.ratio > 0}
{/if}
{/if}
{/each}
{#if gauge.stale}{/if} {#each columns as col} {/each}
{#if open && details}
{ if (hovering(e)) later(hide, CLOSE_DELAY); }}> {#if details.title}
{details.title} {#if titleAccounts}{titleAccounts}{/if}

{row.heading} {#if row.groupAccountsText}{row.groupAccountsText}{/if}

{/if}
